items.title_en: Em dashes are fucking amazing
items.title_zh: 破折号真的很神奇
items.summary_en: Em dashes offer a versatile punctuation tool for pacing, emphasis, and clarity in writing, especially in tech docs and UI copy. The piece argues for thoughtful, broad use and provides practical guidelines for when to deploy them.
items.summary_zh: 破折号作为标点符号，能在写作中调控节奏、强调与清晰度，尤其在技术文档与界面文案中尤为有用。文章倡导审慎而广泛地使用，并给出实际的使用场景与指南。

items.title_en: My security camera shipped a GitHub admin token in its login page
items.title_zh: 我的安防摄像头在登录页暴露了一个 GitHub 管理员令牌
items.summary_en: A security camera shipped with a GitHub admin token embedded in its login page, potentially exposing credentials to anyone who visits. This incident highlights IoT authentication risks, insecure UI design, and the importance of secure firmware updates and token rotation.
items.summary_zh: 安防摄像头的登录页暴露了一个 GitHub 管理员令牌，可能被任意访问者利用。这一事件凸显物联网认证风险、界面安全设计不足，以及对固件更新和令牌轮换的迫切需求。

items.title_en: Patreon laying off 20% of staff
items.title_zh: Patreon 宣布裁员 20%
items.summary_en: Patreon announces a 20% workforce reduction as part of a broader cost-cutting push, impacting creators and employees and highlighting volatility in creator economy businesses.
items.summary_zh: Patreon 宣布裁员 20%，作为更广泛的成本削减的一部分，影响到创作者与员工，并暴露出创作者经济商业模式的波动性。

items.title_en: It's getting harder to focus every day
items.title_zh: 专注力每天都在下降
items.summary_en: Focus is slipping in an age of constant distractions—from notifications to algorithmic feeds. The piece suggests practical shifts like batching deep work, reducing context switching, and hardening personal workflows to reclaim attention.
items.summary_zh: 在持续的通知和算法信息流冲击下，专注力日益下降。文中给出减少分心、将深度工作集中在固定时段，以及优化日常工作流等应对策略。

items.title_en: Flux 3
items.title_zh: Flux 3 版本更新
items.summary_en: Flux 3 marks the next major version of Flux.
items.summary_zh: Flux 3 标志着 Flux 的下一重大版本。

items.title_en: Nothing works and everyone is euphoric
items.title_zh: 没有什么能用，但人人都很欣喜
items.summary_en: An exploration of a culture where systems frequently fail yet people ride the hype wave. It examines why optimism persists in tech despite broken tools—and what it means for product design and employee expectations.
items.summary_zh: 探讨在系统频繁失效却充满“兴奋”氛围的科技文化。分析为何在工具出问题时，群体仍保持乐观，以及这对产品设计与员工期望意味着什么。

items.title_en: Flux 3 X Mimic: The Next Generation of Video-Action Models
items.title_zh: Flux 3 X Mimic：视频动作模型的下一代
items.summary_en: Flux 3 X Mimic represents the next generation of video-action models, combining efficiency with stronger temporal understanding. Expect improvements in real-time recognition, multi-camera setups, and potential applications in search, robotics, and content analysis.
items.summary_zh: Flux 3 X Mimic 展示了视频动作模型的下一代，强调在效率与时序理解上的提升。对视频检索、机器人与多摄像场景等应用有潜在影响。

items.title_en: Open Weights and American AI Leadership [pdf]
items.title_zh: Open Weights 与美国 AI 领导力 [PDF]
items.summary_en: A PDF discussing Open Weights and the U.S. stance on AI leadership, outlining openness, policy, and strategic considerations for responsible AI development.
items.summary_zh: 一份关于 Open Weights 与美国在 AI 领导力方面立场的文档，探讨开放性、政策与负责任 AI 发展的战略考量。

items.title_en: Oracle fires 21,000 employees to fund AI spending
items.title_zh: Oracle 解雇 2.1 万员工以资助 AI 开支
items.summary_en: Oracle announces significant layoffs to fund AI initiatives, illustrating corporate appetite for AI-led growth while raising concerns about workforce impact and knowledge continuity.
items.summary_zh: Oracle 宣布大规模裁员以资助 AI 项目，反映企业对 AI 驱动增长的热情，同时引发对员工影响与知识延续的担忧。

items.title_en: Government orders GitHub to remove Bluetooth-based chat app Bitchat: Jack Dorsey
items.title_zh: 政府要求 GitHub 下架蓝牙聊天应用 Bitchat，涉及安全担忧
items.summary_en: A government directive orders removal of a Bluetooth-based chat app linked to a high-profile figure, citing security concerns. The case highlights how policy actions intersect with platform hosting and privacy in distributed apps.
items.summary_zh: 政府指令要求下架与高知名人物相关的蓝牙聊天应用，因安全担忧而采取行动。此事凸显政策行为与平台托管、隐私在分布式应用场景中的交叉影响。

items.title_en: Writing by hand is good for your brain
items.title_zh: 手写对大脑有益
items.summary_en: Handwriting engages motor memory and deeper processing, often boosting recall more than typing for learning tasks. The act of forming letters seems to strengthen neural connections that support long-term memory and understanding. For students and knowledge workers, mixing handwritten notes with digital tools can improve retention.
items.summary_zh: 手写能激活运动记忆并促使更深入的信息处理，常常比打字在学习任务中带来更高的记忆保留。手写过程有助于强化支持长期记忆和理解的神经连接。对于学生和知识工作者，混合使用手写笔记与数字工具有利于提升记忆留存。

items.title_en: The day Steve Jobs dissed me in a keynote (2010)
items.title_zh: 2010 年 Steve Jobs 在一次主题演讲中嘲讽了我
items.summary_en: A personal anecdote from 2010 about an incident with Steve Jobs during a keynote, offering insights into public perception, product narrative, and the human side of iconic tech leaders.
items.summary_zh: 讲述 2010 年在一次主题演讲中被 Steve Jobs 点评的个人趣事，揭示公众认知、产品叙事以及科技偶像背后的真实一面。

items.title_en: Buz – A fork of Bun using modern Zig, with sub-1s incremental builds
items.title_zh: Buz — 用 Zig 实现的 Bun 派生，具亚秒级增量构建
items.summary_en: Buz is a Bun fork implemented in Zig that promises sub-second incremental builds, accelerating developer feedback for JavaScript tooling. It aims to be a drop-in replacement with a modern, faster build pipeline.
items.summary_zh: Buz 是用 Zig 实现的 Bun 派生，承诺实现亚秒级增量构建，加速 JavaScript 工具链的开发反馈。目标是成为无缝替代品，提供更快的构建流水线。

items.title_en: IRGC Claims It Destroyed Amazon's Bahrain Data Center
items.title_zh: 伊朗革命卫队称摧毁亚马逊在巴林的数据中心
items.summary_en: An IRGC-linked claim alleges destruction of a data center in Bahrain, raising questions about attribution and the risk to critical infrastructure. Verification is unclear, but such statements amplify concerns about cyber violence and regional security.
items.summary_zh: 伊朗革命卫队相关方声称摧毁巴林的一座数据中心，引发对归因和关键基础设施风险的讨论。尚无独立核实，但此类表述放大了对网络暴力与区域安全的担忧。

items.title_en: I Tried Building a Real App with AI. It Took a Year
items.title_zh: 我用 AI 构建真实应用花了一年时间
items.summary_en: A year-long experiment building a real app with AI reveals practical gaps between vision and execution, highlighting data, tooling, and product management challenges.
items.summary_zh: 用 AI 构建真实应用的年度实验揭示了从愿景到实现之间的实际差距，涉及数据、工具与产品管理等挑战。

items.title_en: Hetzner is working on LLM Inference
items.title_zh: Hetzner 正在研究 LLM 推理
items.summary_en: Hetzner is exploring LLM inference, signaling a push toward private, cost-controlled AI workloads on affordable hardware and expanding options for managed AI hosting.
items.summary_zh: Hetzner 正在探索大模型推理，标志着在负担得起的硬件上推行私有化、成本可控的 AI 负载，并拓展托管 AI 的选项。

items.title_en: Startup founders urge U.S. government not to shut off Chinese open weight AI
items.title_zh: 创业者敦促特朗普不要切断对中国开源权重 AI 的访问
items.summary_en: Founders argue that cutting off access to Chinese open-weight AI would throttle innovation, raise costs, and fragment global collaboration. They call for governance and standards instead of broad bans, highlighting that open weights accelerate safety research and tooling when responsibly managed.
items.summary_zh: 创始人认为切断中国开源权重 AI 的访问会扼杀创新、提高成本，并分裂全球协作。他们呼吁以治理和标准取代全面禁令，强调在负责任管理下，开源权重能加速安全研究和工具开发。

items.title_en: Claude Cookbook
items.title_zh: Claude 使用手册
items.summary_en: Claude Cookbook compiles practical prompts, workflows, and recipes to get the most out of Claude across tasks like writing, data analysis, and coding. It highlights patterns for prompt engineering, guardrails, and chaining Claude's responses for robust outputs.
items.summary_zh: Claude Cookbook 汇集了在 Claude 上高效完成各类任务的提示、工作流程和使用范式，涵盖写作、数据分析与编程等场景。它总结了提示工程的常用模式、对话约束以及将多轮回复整合成可靠产出的策略。

items.title_en: 98.css
items.title_zh: 98.css：让网页重现 Windows 98 风格的 CSS 框架
items.summary_en: 98.css is a tiny CSS framework that recreates Windows 98-era UI with modern HTML. It enables quick retro-style demos and nostalgia-driven UI experiments without heavy dependencies. The project showcases how small CSS kits can deliver a complete desktop-like aesthetic with just a few lines.
items.summary_zh: 98.css 是一个小型 CSS 框架，能够把网页渲染成 Windows 98 时代的界面。它便于快速做出复古风格的仪表板或演示，而无需繁重的依赖。该项目展示了极简 CSS 组件也能实现桌面级美观的效果。

items.title_en: Half-Life 2 running natively on HaikuOS
items.title_zh: HaikuOS 上 Half-Life 2 原生运行
items.summary_en: Half-Life 2 now runs natively on HaikuOS, showcasing progress in game compatibility and driver support for the niche OS. It demonstrates the vitality of hobbyist ecosystems and the potential for broader software ecosystems on smaller platforms.
items.summary_zh: Half-Life 2 现已在 HaikuOS 上原生运行，展示了该小众操作系统在游戏兼容性与驱动支持方面的进展，体现了爱好者生态的活力以及小众平台上扩大软件生态的潜力。

items.title_en: 3GPP Version 19
items.title_zh: 3GPP 第19 版
items.summary_en: 3GPP Release 19 formalizes new capabilities for 5G and beyond, including uplink improvements, enhanced MIMO, and network optimization features. The spec helps operators plan for higher throughput and more reliable services as networks mature.
items.summary_zh: 3GPP 第19版正式确立面向5G及未来的新能力，包括上行改进、增强型大规模MIMO和网络优化特性，为运营商在网络成熟阶段提升吞吐量与可靠性提供了规划依据。

items.title_en: Why is programming so captivating, yet so agonizing?
items.title_zh: 为什么编程如此吸引人却又如此痛苦？
items.summary_en: Programming delivers deep problem-solving satisfaction and immediate feedback, but is often punishing due to edge cases, debugging drags, and burnout. The piece reflects on the emotional rollercoaster of building software and strategies to cope.
items.summary_zh: 编程带来深度的问题解决满足感和即时反馈，但常因边界条件、调试拖延和倦怠而变得痛苦。文章反思构建软件过程中的情感曲线，并给出应对策略。

items.title_en: Show HN: Echo – Fable-level results at 1/3 the cost using open-weight models
items.title_zh: Show HN：Echo——用开放权重模型以三分之一成本获得同级别结果
items.summary_en: Echo demonstrates top-tier results at about one-third the cost by using open-weight models. This highlights the viability of open-weight AI for cost-sensitive deployments, though tradeoffs in support and ecosystem maturity remain.
items.summary_zh: Echo 在开放权重模型的帮助下，以约三分之一的成本取得接近顶级基准的结果，显示开源权重在降低 AI 部署成本方面的潜力。与此同时，生态成熟度和技术支持等取舍需要考虑。

items.title_en: AI Companies Are Trying to Hide a Staggering Amount of Debt
items.title_zh: AI 公司正隐藏巨额债务
items.summary_en: AI firms have reportedly buried large debt off their balance sheets, highlighting a riskier funding landscape as capital markets back AI bets. The disclosure questions the true financial health of high-flying AI startups and their burn rates.
items.summary_zh: 据称 AI 公司在账面之外隐藏了巨额债务，暴露在对 AI 投资热潮中的资金风险。此类披露质疑这些高增长企业的真实财务状况和资金消耗速度。

items.title_en: The IBM PC, Part 1: Arrival
items.title_zh: IBM PC 的到来（第一部分）
items.summary_en: A narrative on how the IBM PC arrived and reshaped computing, covering early hardware choices, BIOS dynamics, and the shift from hobbyist tinkering to mainstream business use.
items.summary_zh: 讲述 IBM PC 如何进入市场并重塑计算领域，涵盖早期硬件选择、BIOS 生态，以及从爱好者到主流商务计算的转变。

items.title_en: Couple pay >$800k for a gene-editing therapy for their daughter. She died.
items.title_zh: 夫妻为女儿的基因编辑治疗花费超80万美元，最终去世
items.summary_en: A Chinese couple spent over $800k on an experimental gene-editing therapy for their daughter, but she did not survive. The case spotlights the high stakes and unresolved ethical and regulatory questions around unproven, expensive treatments and the need for transparency in trial results.
items.summary_zh: 一对中国夫妻为女儿的基因编辑治疗花费超过80万美元，但治疗未能挽救她的生命。此案凸显了高成本、未证实治疗的风险，以及试验透明度和监管伦理方面的紧迫问题。

items.title_en: Jensen Huang on why open models matter
items.title_zh: 黄仁勋谈开源模型为何重要
items.summary_en: Jensen Huang argues that open models matter for innovation, interoperability, and risk management, outlining how openness can accelerate AI progress while inviting discussion on governance.
items.summary_zh: 黄仁勋认为开源模型对创新、互操作性和风险管理至关重要，阐述开放性如何加速 AI 进展，并引发对治理的讨论。

items.title_en: Programming language file extensions that match ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code
items.title_zh: 编程语言文件扩展名与 ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 国家代码的映射
items.summary_en: A quirky mapping shows programming language file extensions that collide with ISO country codes, prompting questions about naming conventions and potential tooling collisions.
items.summary_zh: 展示了编程语言文件扩展名与 ISO 国家代码冲突的有趣映射，提出命名规范和工具链冲突的思考。

items.title_en: Kaizen #4: Overhauled Homelab
items.title_zh: Kaizen 第4期：全面改造自家实验室
items.summary_en: Kaizen 4 documents a major overhaul of a home lab, likely detailing hardware choices, automation, and monitoring upgrades within a culture of continuous improvement.
items.summary_zh: Kaizen 第4期记录对自家实验室的重大改造，可能涉及硬件选择、自动化与监控升级，以及持续改进的理念。

items.title_en: I regret migrating to Codeberg
items.title_zh: 我后悔迁移到 Codeberg
items.summary_en: A personal critique of migrating to Codeberg, weighing issues like reliability, community, and tools against the allure of alternative platforms.
items.summary_zh: 作者分享迁移到 Codeberg 的个人体验，权衡可靠性、社区生态与工具链等因素，与其他平台的优劣进行比较。

items.title_en: What happened to TheNumbers.com
items.title_zh: TheNumbers.com 究竟发生了什么？
items.summary_en: TheNumbers.com has undergone a notable disruption, highlighting data reliability concerns for publicly tracked entertainment metrics.
items.summary_zh: TheNumbers.com 遭遇了显著变化，凸显公众追踪的娱乐数据可靠性问题。

items.title_en: Game of Trees – Git-based version control from OpenBSD folks
items.title_zh: Game of Trees — 来自 OpenBSD 的 Git 风格版本控制
items.summary_en: Game of Trees proposes a Git-inspired version control approach from the OpenBSD community, emphasizing robustness, simplicity, and security-conscious design.
items.summary_zh: Game of Trees 来自 OpenBSD 社群，提出一种受 Git 启发的版本控制思路，强调鲁棒性、简洁性与安全性。

items.title_en: Terence Tao's ChatGPT conversation about the Jacobian Conjecture counterexample
items.title_zh: 陶哲軒與 ChatGPT 的 Jacobian 猜想反例對話
items.summary_en: Terrence Tao engages ChatGPT in a discussion about the Jacobian Conjecture, exploring a potential counterexample and the AI's reasoning limits. The exchange highlights both the promise and the pitfalls of using language models for advanced mathematical problem-solving.
items.summary_zh: 宇宙数学大师泰罗（Terrence Tao）与 ChatGPT 展开对话，探讨雅可比猜想的潜在反例及 AI 推理的局限性。此互动凸显了将大型语言模型用于高层次数学推理的前景与风险。

items.title_en: AMD's Instinct MI455X: Aiming for the Sun
items.title_zh: AMD 的 Instinct MI455X：直指高性能 AI
items.summary_en: AMD's Instinct MI455X targets demanding AI workloads with ambitious performance goals, signaling ongoing competition with Nvidia in data-center accelerators.
items.summary_zh: AMD 的 Instinct MI455X 面向高端 AI 工作负载，设定雄心勃勃的性能目标，继续与英伟达在数据中心加速器领域竞争。

items.title_en: Why Software Factories Fail (or: harness engineering is not enough)
items.title_zh: 为什么软件工厂会失败（或：仅靠工程化不足以成事）
items.summary_en: The piece argues that software factories fail not because of tech per se but due to overreliance on harness engineering and process alone. The piece suggests you need broader context engineering, governance, and guardrails to build reliable AI-enabled software.
items.summary_zh: 本文指出，仅靠工程化流程难以解决 AI 驱动工作流的复杂性，需要更广义的上下文工程、治理和守则，才能实现可可靠扩展的开发。

items.title_en: Co-Opting Linux Processes for High-Performance Network Simulation (2022)
items.title_zh: 在高性能网络仿真中共用 Linux 进程（2022）
items.summary_en: A 2022 USENIX ATC talk discusses co-opting Linux processes to boost performance in network simulations, including techniques like process pinning and IPC optimizations. The ideas inform HPC-focused network research.
items.summary_zh: 2022 年的 USENIX ATC 演讲探讨如何在网络仿真中协同利用 Linux 进程提升性能，涵盖进程绑定和 IPC 优化等技术，对高性能计算导向的网络研究具有启发性。

items.title_en: The arguments against open source AI are bad
items.title_zh: 反对开源 AI 的论点很糟糕
items.summary_en: The author contends that the main objections to open-source AI are flawed and short-sighted. Open models can improve safety, transparency, and collaboration, while centralized systems risk lock-in and opacity.
items.summary_zh: 作者认为反对开源 AI 的论点存在明显缺陷。开源模型能提升安全性、透明度和协作，而中心化系统则带来垄断和透明度不足的问题。

items.title_en: The Book Prize Index
items.title_zh: 图书奖项索引
items.summary_en: A searchable index of literary prize winners and finalists helps researchers track prestige, trends, and credentials across the literary landscape.
items.summary_zh: 可搜索的文学奖项索引，帮助研究者追踪各类奖项的声望、趋势与资历。

items.title_en: Software rendering in 500 lines of bare C++
items.title_zh: 用 500 行裸 C++ 实现的软件渲染器
items.summary_en: A tiny software renderer demonstrates the core pipeline in about 500 lines of C++, including triangle setup, rasterization, and shading. It’s a practical reminder that many graphics fundamentals can be explored without a GPU, reinforcing how GPUs abstract complexity.
items.summary_zh: 一个极简的软件渲染器用约 500 行 C++ 展示了三角形处理、光栅化和着色等核心管线。它提醒人们在没有GPU的情况下也能理解图形学基本原理，凸显了 GPU 对复杂性的封装作用。

items.title_en: Mag Computer: A Mag History of RAM (1960–2025)
items.title_zh: Mag Computer：RAM 的历史（1960–2025）
items.summary_en: A long-form look at RAM's evolution from early magnetic memory to modern DRAM and beyond, highlighting architectural shifts, cost pressures, and performance milestones.
items.summary_zh: 从早期磁芯内存到现代 DRAM 的 RAM 演变史，聚焦体系结构变革、成本压力与性能里程碑。

items.title_en: The Reddit Problem – How a Reddit Alternative Was Banned from RedditAlternatives
items.title_zh: Reddit 的问题——我们的 Reddit 替代站如何被 RedditAlternatives 禁用
items.summary_en: A look at how a Reddit alternative was banned from RedditAlternatives, highlighting governance, moderation policies, and the fragility of niche communities within platform ecosystems.
items.summary_zh: 探讨一个 Reddit 替代站如何在 RedditAlternatives 被禁用，聚焦治理、审核政策与平台生态中小众社区的脆弱性。

items.title_en: OpenAI’s accidental attack against Hugging Face is science fiction that happened
items.title_zh: OpenAI 的意外攻击对 Hugging Face 就是真实的科幻
items.summary_en: An analysis arguing that OpenAI's accidental cyber attack on Hugging Face mirrors a sci-fi security scenario playing out in the real world, highlighting cross-platform security risks.
items.summary_zh: 分析认为 OpenAI 误发的针对 Hugging Face 的网络攻击如同现实中上演的科幻式安全场景，凸显跨平台安全风险。

items.title_en: Learn OpenGL, extensive tutorial resource for learning Modern OpenGL
items.title_zh: LearnOpenGL：学习现代 OpenGL 的全面教程资源
items.summary_en: LearnOpenGL is a thorough, beginner-friendly resource that guides readers through modern OpenGL concepts with practical examples and progressively challenging projects. It’s a go-to reference for developers building cross-platform graphics apps.
items.summary_zh: LearnOpenGL 是一本全面、对初学者友好的资源，带你从现代 OpenGL 的核心概念入手，配以实战示例与渐进式项目，成为跨平台图形开发的权威参考。

items.title_en: Why Sony can't bring back its classic Walkman models
items.title_zh: 为什么索尼无法让经典 Walkman 重现
items.summary_en: The piece argues nostalgia aside, Sony's classic Walkman can't be realistically revived due to supply chain constraints, licensing, and shifting consumer behavior. It highlights how modern wearables, streaming, and digital rights complicate a hardware comeback. The takeaway is that beloved devices may be unfeasible even for big brands.
items.summary_zh: 尽管存在情怀，索尼很难真正让经典 Walkman 重新回归，原因在于供应链约束、授权与消费行为的转变。现代可穿戴设备、流媒体和数字版权也让硬件复兴变得更加复杂。结论是，即使是大品牌，也未必能让心头好的设备重现。

items.title_en: DARPA, U.S. Air Force fly AI-controlled F-16
items.title_zh: DARPA 与美军空军测试 AI 控制的 F-16
items.summary_en: DARPA and the Air Force conducted a test flight of an AI-controlled F-16, demonstrating autonomy in high-stakes flight and highlighting ongoing work to augment pilots with intelligent systems while preserving human oversight.
items.summary_zh: DARPA 与美国空军完成 AI 控制的 F-16 的试飞，展示了高风险飞行中的自主能力，同时强调在提高飞行安全的同时保留人机协作。

items.title_en: Interview with a Maintainer
items.title_zh: 与维护者的访谈
items.summary_en: An insider look at open-source maintenance, covering the trade-offs between stability, speed, and community needs, plus tips for aspiring maintainers.
items.summary_zh: 从维护者视角揭示开源维护的取舍，包括稳定性、速度与社区需求之间的权衡，以及给未来维护者的建议。

items.title_en: Astronomers may have found the first exomoon
items.title_zh: 天文学家可能发现首颗系外卫星
items.summary_en: Astronomers report evidence for a moon orbiting an exoplanet, a candidate exomoon. If confirmed, it would be the first known moon beyond the solar system and would open new questions about moon formation in other systems and how common such satellites are.
items.summary_zh: 天文学家报告了绕系外行星运行的卫星的证据，这是一个候选的系外卫星。如果被确认，它将成为首颗已知的系外卫星，为研究其他星系中的卫星形成及其普遍性带来新问题。

items.title_en: Building on ATProto
items.title_zh: 在 ATProto 上构建应用
items.summary_en: ATProto is designed to enable interoperable, decentralized social apps. This write-up outlines practical patterns for building on ATProto, covering core concepts like authentication, data models, and tooling to help developers ship apps that can interoperate across services.
items.summary_zh: ATProto 旨在为去中心化的可互操作社交应用提供基础。本篇文章给出在 ATProto 上开发的实用做法与模式，涵盖身份认证、数据模型和开发工具等要点，帮助开发者构建跨服务互操作的应用。

items.title_en: Preventing line breaks in <code> elements
items.title_zh: 在 <code> 元素中防止换行
items.summary_en: A practical CSS note explains how to prevent line breaks inside inline code elements, preserving readability for short literals and commands.
items.summary_zh: 一条实用的 CSS 提示，讲解如何防止内联代码元素中的换行，保持短文本和命令的可读性。

items.title_en: The Visual 6502
items.title_zh: The Visual 6502：交互式 6502 CPU 可视化仿真器
items.summary_en: The Visual 6502 is a web-based interactive simulator of the 6502 CPU, designed for learning and experimentation. It lets you step through instructions, view register states, and observe how code executes on a classic microprocessor. It's a delightful resource for retrocomputing education and systems curiosity.
items.summary_zh: The Visual 6502 是一个基于网页的交互式 6502 CPU 模拟器，面向教学与实验。它允许你逐步执行指令、查看寄存器状态，并观察代码在经典处理器上的执行过程。是学习与体验复古计算的有趣资源。

items.title_en: Fields Medals 2026
items.title_zh: 菲尔兹奖 2026
items.summary_en: Fields Medal 2026 winners announced, highlighting breakthroughs in mathematics with potential cross-pollination to CS theory and algorithms.
items.summary_zh: 2026 年菲尔兹奖得主揭晓，强调在数学领域的突破，并可能对计算机科学理论与算法产生影响。

items.title_en: The PImpl idiom and the C++26 std:indirect type
items.title_zh: PImpl 习语与 C++26 的 std::indirect 类型
items.summary_en: Examines how the PImpl (pointer to implementation) idiom interacts with the new std::indirect type proposed for C++26, including implications for ABI stability, encapsulation, and code ergonomics. Provides concrete guidance on when and how to adopt std::indirect with PImpl, and potential pitfalls.
items.summary_zh: 本文解析 PImpl 习语与 C++26 的 std::indirect 类型之间的关系。它讨论对 ABI 稳定性、封装性和可用性的影响，并给出在实际代码中结合二者的建议与常见陷阱。

items.title_en: Show HN: Palmier Pro – Open-source macOS video editor built for AI
items.title_zh: Palmier Pro——面向 AI 的开源 macOS 视频编辑器
items.summary_en: Palmier Pro is an open-source macOS video editor tailored for AI workflows, enabling AI-assisted editing and extensibility through community contributions.
items.summary_zh: Palmier Pro 是面向 AI 工作流的开源 macOS 视频编辑器，强调 AI 辅助编辑，并通过社区贡献实现可扩展性。

items.title_en: Show HN: X402vps – Docker containers for AI agents, paid per hour with USDC
items.title_zh: Show HN：X402vps — 按小时用 USDC 计费的 AI 代理 Docker 容器
items.summary_en: X402vps offers Docker containers designed for AI agents, billed hourly in USDC, highlighting a cryptoeconomic model for flexible AI compute.
items.summary_zh: X402vps 提供面向 AI 代理的 Docker 容器，按小时以 USDC 计费，展示了灵活 AI 计算的加密经济模型。

items.title_en: Introducing selfie for sign-in: a new way to access your Google Account
items.title_zh: 自拍登录：一种更便捷访问 Google 账户的新方式
items.summary_en: Google's selfie-based sign-in offers a convenient authentication method powered by biometrics. It improves ease of access but raises privacy and security questions about biometric data and spoofing risk.
items.summary_zh: Google 推出基于自拍的登录方式，利用生物识别提升认证便捷性。与此同时也引发对生物识别数据隐私和潜在欺骗风险的担忧。

items.title_en: Show HN: Audio Player with "Binaural Beats" tuned to the same key as your music
items.title_zh: Show HN：音频播放器，Binaural Beats 与音乐同调
items.summary_en: An audio player that tunes binaural beats to the same key as the current track, exploring potential focus and mood-enhancing effects with practical demos.
items.summary_zh: 一个将双耳节拍调到当前音乐同调的音频播放器，探索提升专注与情绪的潜在效果，并附有实操演示。

items.title_en: Writing a Debugger from Scratch
items.title_zh: 从零开始编写调试器
items.summary_en: A practical guide to building a debugger from scratch, covering architecture decisions, symbol loading, breakpoints, and debugging models.
items.summary_zh: 从零开始编写调试器的实用指南，涵盖架构决策、符号加载、断点实现与调试模型等要点。

items.title_en: Show HN: Claude-thermos keeps your Claude session warm for you
items.title_zh: Claude-thermos：让 Claude 会话保持热身状态
items.summary_en: Claude-thermos keeps your Claude session warm, reducing cold-start latency for long-running prompts. It makes interactive AI sessions feel more responsive.
items.summary_zh: Claude-thermos 能保持 Claude 会话持续活跃，降低冷启动延迟，使互动更流畅。

items.title_en: A solid-state “atomic channel” for separating rare earth elements
items.title_zh: 用于分离稀土元素的固态原子通道
items.summary_en: Researchers report a solid-state atomic channel for separating rare earth elements, potentially enabling cleaner, more energy-efficient purification. If scalable, this approach could reduce the environmental footprint of critical materials used in electronics and clean energy sectors.
items.summary_zh: 研究人员提出一种固态原子通道用于分离稀土元素，或实现更高效、环境友好的纯化过程。若可扩展，这种方法可能降低电子、清洁能源领域关键材料的环境足迹。

items.title_en: The Beam Engine
items.title_zh: Beam 引擎
items.summary_en: A compact computational engine called The Beam Engine is presented, highlighting its minimalist design and potential use cases.
items.summary_zh: 一个名为 The Beam Engine 的紧凑型计算引擎被展示，强调其极简设计及潜在应用场景。

items.title_en: JEP 540: Simple JSON API (Now in Incubator)
items.title_zh: JEP 540：简单 JSON API（现进入孵化器阶段）
items.summary_en: JEP 540 adds a Simple JSON API for Java, aiming to simplify JSON handling and reduce boilerplate. It’s in the Incubator, signaling early-stage experimentation and questions about long‑term stability for Java developers.
items.summary_zh: JEP 540 为 Java 引入了简单的 JSON API，旨在简化 JSON 的处理，减少样板代码。它处于孵化阶段，预示着 Java 开发者需要关注长期稳定性与兼容性问题。

items.title_en: PCI DSS DMARC Requirement: What Section 5.4.1 Requires
items.title_zh: PCI DSS DMARC 要求：第 5.4.1 条款
items.summary_en: The post clarifies what PCI DSS DMARC Section 5.4.1 requires for email security in card environments, including practical steps to achieve compliance.
items.summary_zh: 文章澄清 PCI DSS DMARC 第 5.4.1 条款对于支付卡环境的邮件安全要求，以及实现合规的实际步骤。

items.title_en: My Emacs Configuration (Dired)
items.title_zh: 我的 Emacs 配置（Dired）
items.summary_en: A tour of a customized Emacs setup centered on Dired, sharing tips for file management, automation, and fast workflows.
items.summary_zh: 一份以 Dired 为核心的 Emacs 配置指南，分享文件管理、自动化与高效工作流的技巧。

items.title_en: Emacs Is a Lispboard
items.title_zh: Emacs 就是一个 Lispboard
items.summary_en: Emacs is described as a Lispboard, highlighting its Lisp-based extensibility and the culture of customizing the editor for deep programming work.
items.summary_zh: 将 Emacs 比作 Lispboard，强调其基于 Lisp 的可扩展性以及为深度编程而定制编辑器的文化。

items.title_en: Learn WebGPU for C++
items.title_zh: 用 C++ 学习 WebGPU
items.summary_en: A guide to WebGPU tailored for C++ developers, covering the basics and how to leverage WebGPU from C++ code, bridging native and web GPU programming.
items.summary_zh: 面向 C++ 开发者的 WebGPU 学习指南，介绍基础知识以及如何在 C++ 中利用 WebGPU，架起本地和网页 GPU 编程的桥梁。

items.title_en: Show HN: OneCLI – OSS credential gateway that keeps secrets out of AI agents
items.title_zh: OneCLI：开源凭证网关，让秘密不落入 AI 代理
items.summary_en: OneCLI provides an open-source credential gateway that keeps secrets out of AI prompts while still enabling automated workflows. It aims to reduce risk from leaking credentials through model access.
items.summary_zh: OneCLI 提供一个开源凭证网关，让秘密不再通过 AI 提示被暴露，同时仍然支持自动化工作流。

items.title_en: Mourning Dan Williams
items.title_zh: 缅怀 Dan Williams
items.summary_en: Dan Williams, a notable contributor to Linux and open-source security research, passed away, prompting tributes from the community. His legacy lives on through the projects he helped shape.
items.summary_zh: Linux 与开源安全领域的知名贡献者 Dan Williams 去世，社区致以哀悼。文中强调他在内核开发与密码学工作中的影响，提醒人们科技领域背后的人文维度。他的遗产仍通过他参与的项目继续延续。

items.title_en: Show HN: Remux – an open-source tmux workspace designed for iPhone
items.title_zh: Remux：面向 iPhone 的开源 tmux 工作区
items.summary_en: Remux is an open-source tmux workspace redesigned for iPhone, aiming to provide a mobile-friendly interface and improved workflows for TUI users.
items.summary_zh: Remux 是面向 iPhone 的开源 tmux 工作区，为移动端提供更友好的界面和改进的工作流。

items.title_en: Launch HN: Screenpipe (YC S26) – Record how you work and turn that into agents
items.title_zh: Screenpipe（YC S26）——记录工作流程并转化为代理
items.summary_en: Screenpipe records how you work and turns that into autonomous agents. The approach promises to automate workflows and boost productivity, but also raises concerns about data privacy and security.
items.summary_zh: Screenpipe 记录你的工作流程并将其转化为可执行的代理，帮助自动化日常任务并提升生产力。此方法带来自动化的潜力，同时也引发数据隐私与安全方面的担忧。

items.title_en: WebGPU Unleashed: A Practical Tutorial
items.title_zh: WebGPU 大放异彩：实战教程
items.summary_en: A hands-on WebGPU tutorial showing how to leverage GPU compute in the browser, including shader basics, buffers, and performance tips.
items.summary_zh: 一份面向实操的 WebGPU 教程，展示如何在浏览器中利用 GPU 进行计算，涵盖着色器基础、缓冲区与性能优化要点。

items.title_en: Plants vs. Zombies for PlayStation 2
items.title_zh: PlayStation 2 上的 Plants vs. Zombies
items.summary_en: A fan-made port of Plants vs. Zombies to PS2 showcases retro development ingenuity and the enduring appeal of classic platforms, with trade-offs in performance and compatibility.
items.summary_zh: 粉丝自制将植物大战僵尸移植到 PS2，体现了对经典平台的创造力与热情，同时也带来性能与兼容性的权衡。

items.title_en: Geekbench 7
items.title_zh: Geekbench 7
items.summary_en: Geekbench 7 updates the benchmark suite with revised CPU tests and a new ML workload; it broadens platform coverage to reflect modern hardware. The update helps developers and buyers compare performance more accurately in AI-augmented workloads.
items.summary_zh: Geekbench 7 更新了 CPU 测试并引入新的机器学习工作负载，扩展了对更多平台的覆盖。该版本帮助开发者和买家在 AI 相关任务上更准确地比较性能。

items.title_en: Kimi K3 exploited the latest Redis server
items.title_zh: Kimi K3 利用最新 Redis 服务器的漏洞
items.summary_en: A report notes that a researcher used the latest Redis server to demonstrate a notable exploitation, highlighting ongoing security considerations for in-memory data stores. It illustrates how vendor updates and patch cycles interact with exploit discovery. The takeaway is the importance of timely updates and careful exposure of interfaces.
items.summary_zh: 报道指出研究者利用最新的 Redis 服务器演示了一个显著利用案例，凸显了内存数据存储的持续安全议题。它说明了厂商更新与漏洞披露之间的博弈以及打补丁的时效性。结论是要及时更新并谨慎暴露接口。

items.title_en: Stinkpot: SQLite-Backed Shell History
items.title_zh: Stinkpot：SQLite 支撑的 Shell 历史
items.summary_en: Stinkpot stores shell history in SQLite for powerful querying and analysis, enabling pattern discovery and reproducibility across shell sessions.
items.summary_zh: Stinkpot 将 shell 历史存储在 SQLite 中，便于强力查询与分析，促进对 shell 会话的模式发现与可重复性。

items.title_en: It's an Apple Lisa, on a FPGA
items.title_zh: 在 FPGA 上实现的 Apple Lisa
items.summary_en: A hardware project recreates the Apple Lisa computer on an FPGA, enabling authentic emulation of its 1980s GUI and software. The effort highlights how FPGA-based recreations preserve vintage systems and educate new generations about early personal computing.
items.summary_zh: 这是一个把 Apple Lisa 在 FPGA 上实现的硬件项目，能够原汁原味地仿真其 1980 年代的图形用户界面与软件。该工作展示了 FPGA 重现古早系统的价值，也有助于新一代了解早期个人计算。

items.title_en: Technology is a slippery slope to the bottom
items.title_zh: 科技是走向底线的滑坡
items.summary_en: The post argues that technology can gradually erode standards or moral boundaries if not guided by thoughtful design and governance. It suggests caution and concrete practices to keep innovation from undermining user agency, privacy, or long-term value.
items.summary_zh: 文章认为若缺乏周全的设计与治理，科技会逐步侵蚀标准或道德底线，应保持警惕并采取具体做法，以防创新侵蚀用户主导性、隐私或长期价值。

items.title_en: Show HN: A factory simulator game built on Spreadsheets
items.title_zh: Show HN：一个基于电子表格的工厂模拟游戏
items.summary_en: LogiSheets builds a factory simulator game that runs on spreadsheets, showcasing how spreadsheet tooling can power interactive simulations without custom code. It blurs lines between productivity software and game design, useful as a rapid prototyping or educational tool.
items.summary_zh: LogiSheets 展示了一个在电子表格上运行的工厂仿真游戏，展示电子表格工具如何实现交互式仿真，无需自研代码。它模糊了生产力软件与游戏设计的边界，适合作为快速原型或教育工具。

items.title_en: Show HN: Trifle – Open-source analytics that stores answers, not events
items.title_zh: Trifle：开源分析平台，存储答案而非事件
items.summary_en: Trifle is an open-source analytics platform that stores answers rather than events. This outcome-focused approach emphasizes privacy and simplified analysis of user responses.
items.summary_zh: Trifle 是一个开源分析平台，专注于存储答案而非事件数据，强调面向结果的分析与更高的隐私保护。

items.title_en: India's first privately-developed rocket reaches orbit on dramatic debut launch
items.title_zh: 印度首枚私营开发火箭首次进入轨道
items.summary_en: India's first privately-developed rocket reached orbit on its debut, signaling a new era for the country's private space sector. The milestone underscores growing private capabilities, potential disruption to traditional launch dynamics, and global competition in access to space.
items.summary_zh: 印度首枚私营开发火箭在首秀中进入轨道，标志着印度私营航天进入新阶段。此成就显示私人能力的提升，或对传统发射格局带来影响，并反映全球在进入太空领域的竞争加剧。

items.title_en: What else do people draw on gradient.horse?
items.title_zh: gradient.horse 上还能画出什么？
items.summary_en: A look at how people repurpose the gradient.horse canvas beyond its gradient tool, revealing a surprising mix of logos, illustrations, and meme art.
items.summary_zh: gradient.horse 作为渐变画布，除了渐变本身，人们还用它绘制徽标、插画和梗图等多样作品。该文揭示了简单画布如何激发网络创意，成为有趣视觉趋势的收集地。

items.title_en: Meta Garbage Collection: Using OCaml's GC to GC Rust
items.title_zh: Meta 垃圾回收：用 OCaml 的 GC 为 Rust 做垃圾回收
items.summary_en: A post explains using OCaml's garbage collector to assist in garbage collection for Rust code, illustrating cross-language memory-management ideas and potential tooling hurdles.
items.summary_zh: 一篇博文讨论将 OCaml 的垃圾回收器用于协助 Rust 的内存管理，展示跨语言内存管理的思路与潜在工具挑战。

items.title_en: Converting Files into Minecraft Worlds
items.title_zh: 将文件转换为 Minecraft 世界
items.summary_en: Converting arbitrary files into Minecraft worlds enables data storage and retrieval within game terrain. This creative data-encoding approach could serve as a lightweight data archive, though questions remain about efficiency and accessibility.
items.summary_zh: 将任意文件转换为 Minecraft 世界，实现数据在游戏地形中的存储与提取。这一做法展示了在游戏世界中对数据进行编码与存储的创造性思路，可能用于数据归档和数据隐私相关的应用，同时也带来效率与可访问性的挑战。

items.title_en: Computational chemistry, Locally? My rant on SSH
items.title_zh: 本地化的计算化学？我对 SSH 的吐槽
items.summary_en: The piece argues for local computation in computational chemistry workflows and critiques over-reliance on remote SSH, touching on latency, data privacy, and reproducibility.
items.summary_zh: 文章主张在计算化学工作流中进行本地计算，并批评过度依赖远程 SSH，讨论延迟、数据隐私与可重复性。

items.title_en: Escape Analysis in Go: Stack vs. Heap Allocations Explained
items.title_zh: Go 的逃逸分析：栈与堆分配解析
items.summary_en: Go's escape analysis explains when allocations stay on the stack versus moving to the heap, with direct implications for latency and memory use. The post clarifies how the compiler makes decisions and how developers can optimize hot paths. It helps developers write more predictable, efficient Go code.
items.summary_zh: Go 的逃逸分析解释了何时分配会留在栈上、何时会移动到堆上，以及这对延迟和内存使用的直接影响。文章阐明了编译器如何做出判断，以及开发者如何优化热点路径。帮助开发者编写更可预测、效率更高的 Go 代码。

items.title_en: Quickly rewrite Git repository history
items.title_zh: 快速重写 Git 仓库历史
items.summary_en: Git-filter-repo is a fast tool for rewriting Git history, enabling tasks such as removing sensitive data, changing authors, or pruning large files with safer defaults than older methods. It includes practical examples and tips for patching history without breaking repos.
items.summary_zh: git-filter-repo 提供快速、安全的历史重写能力，支持删除大文件、清除敏感数据、修正作者等操作，相较旧工具有更友善的默认选项。文中给出实用示例与使用要点，帮助在不破坏仓库的前提下改写历史。

items.title_en: Tangleflow: Converts GitHub Actions workflows to tangled workflows and back
items.title_zh: Tangleflow：将 GitHub Actions 工作流互转工具
items.summary_en: Tangleflow enables reversible transformation between structured GitHub Actions workflows and a tangled representation, aiding readability and maintainability of large pipelines.
items.summary_zh: Tangleflow 提供将结构化 GitHub Actions 工作流与缠结表示互相转换的能力，提升大规模自动化管道的可读性与可维护性。

items.title_en: Modula-3 History Collection on Computer History Museum
items.title_zh: 计算机历史博物馆的 Modula-3 历史收藏
items.summary_en: The Modula-3 History Collection at the Computer History Museum preserves documents, artifacts, and interviews about the Modula-3 programming language, its design tradeoffs, and influence on language research. It serves as a resource for historians and language enthusiasts.
items.summary_zh: 计算机历史博物馆的 Modula-3 历史收藏保存了 Modula-3 编程语言的文献、实物与访谈，记录其设计取舍及对语言研究的影响。对于历史学家和语言爱好者而言，这是重要的研究资源。

items.title_en: Freeze-Casting
items.title_zh: 冷冻铸造
items.summary_en: Freeze-casting is a materials processing technique that creates highly porous ceramics by freezing a ceramic slurry and sublimating the ice, leaving a porous structure. It enables lightweight, tunable porosity for filters, bone implants, and other applications.
items.summary_zh: 冷冻铸造是一种通过冷却陶瓷浆料并升华冰晶来形成多孔陶瓷的制造工艺，留下多孔结构。此法实现孔隙度的可控性，使其在过滤、骨科植入物等应用中具有潜在价值。

items.title_en: Latest Airbus Single Aisle Aircraft Innovations
items.title_zh: 最新的 Airbus 单通道机创新
items.summary_en: Airbus’ single-aisle lineup is incorporating cabin comfort, efficiency, and range improvements that alter operating economics and passenger experience on high-demand routes.
items.summary_zh: 空客单通道机型在客舱舒适度、效率与续航方面进行改进，影响高需求航线的运营成本和乘客体验。

items.title_en: The story behind APC-2
items.title_zh: APC-2 的幕后故事
items.summary_en: APC-2, a compact instrument from a well-known maker, is unpacked to reveal design goals, constraints, and market strategy that shaped its release.
items.summary_zh: APC-2 是某知名厂商的紧凑型乐器，文章揭示了其设计目标、约束条件与市场策略背后的故事。

items.title_en: Projects every RC live races and results
items.title_zh: 记录每场遥控赛车现场比赛及结果
items.summary_en: RC Replay tracks and projects every live RC race and its results, offering real-time or archived race-by-race data. The platform enables fans to follow events, compare performances, and analyze trends across sessions.
items.summary_zh: RC Replay 记录并展示每场遥控赛车的现场比赛与结果，提供实时或归档的逐场数据，可能含数据仪表板和对比分析。为遥控赛车爱好者提供追踪赛事、对比表现并分析趋势的途径。

items.title_en: Visualizing the Artemis II Mission
items.title_zh: 阿尔忒弥斯 II 任务可视化
items.summary_en: Foxglove's visualization blog shows visualizations of the Artemis II mission, mapping telemetry, trajectory, timelines, and mission phases to help engineers and enthusiasts understand the complex NASA launch sequence.
items.summary_zh: Foxglove 的可视化博文呈现阿尔忒弥斯 II 任务的遥测数据、轨迹、时间线和任务阶段等信息，帮助工程师与爱好者直观理解复杂的任务流程。
